meta.title: Implement connection pooling for LLM classes to optimize performance
meta.body_summary: Add HTTP connection pooling via Singleton ConnectionPoolManager for OpenAI and LiteLLM classes to reduce overhead and mitigate 299ms asyncio warnings in TaskManager._run_llm_task().

perf_labels.notes: Devin added connection pooling with narrative performance claim but no human review; closed by bot after 8 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 298 changed lines across 6 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor. The PR introduced connection pooling for LLM classes, but was closed without merge after 8 days of inactivity and no maintainer review.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review was conducted; the PR was closed by Devin bot after 7+ days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Connection pooling reduces connection establishment overhead, addressing a 299ms delay in TaskManager._run_llm_task().
review_details.rejection_signals: Auto-closed after 8 days without any reviewer engagement; no CHANGES_REQUESTED or merge attempt.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No fix-attempt cycle; closed by bot after inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Added ConnectionPoolManager singleton in llm.py providing shared aiohttp client sessions for pooled HTTP connections; modified OpenAiLLM to use pooled AsyncOpenAI clients and LiteLLM to integrate pooling; added cleanup in task_manager.py.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Task manager changes integrate cleanup; telephony files are from merge master.

Merge commit brings in master changes (telephony modifications).
